gameDescriptionHtml:
You’ve always thought you could do better, haven’t you?
Signed better players. Played a different way. Snuck the three points.
Well, now’s your chance to live out your footballing dreams…

Go on… accept that big contract and take the reins at your club.
Set your objectives with the board and get to work with the players.
Whose time at the club is over and who’s ready for first team?
Your scouts know who’ll improve your squad, and if you can afford it.

Best roll up those sleeves on the training ground. Your vision needs practice.
Your coaches can help, but only if you’ll let them. Some go it alone…
The media say your tactics are ambitious, and perhaps they are.
Yes, you’d be comfortable in a 4-2-3-1, but that’s how everyone plays…

Now the stadium is packed and the fans are eager. It’s Match Day.
Will you trust your tactics or tinker from the side-lines? Your call, your way.
Because you are the sole author of your team’s destiny. And your path is unique.
The players might take the glory, but their glory is your story.

This is Football Manager 2019
